what_it_does.name: deploy-to-vercel
what_it_does.summary: Instructions for deploying a project to Vercel from an agent, with the Vercel CLI and git. The agent checks for a git remote, a .vercel link and a logged-in CLI, then deploys by git push, by vercel deploy, or without an account through a temporary deployment with a claim URL. Deployments are previews unless the user explicitly asks for production, and the deployment URL is always shown to the user. Use it when the user asks to deploy an app, push it live or create a preview deployment.
tasks: deploy a project to Vercel as a preview, or to production on request
detect the git remote, the .vercel link and the CLI login
select a team and link the project to Vercel
deploy by git push after the user approves
deploy without an account through vercel deploy --temporary
report the deployment URL and build status
works in Claude Code, claude.ai and Codex sandboxes
what_it_does.author_description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use when the user requests deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".

outputs.what: a deployment on Vercel, preview by default, production when the user asks
a temporary deployment that needs no account
outputs.form: a temporary production URL with a claim URL and an expiry
outputs.destination: Vercel, until it expires unless claimed

outputs.what: a linked Vercel project with automatic deployments on future git pushes
a commit of the project pushed to the git remote
outputs.form: a git commit with the message deploy: <description of changes>

outputs.what: the deployment URL, build status, claim URL and expiry

what_it_does.sample_output: Your deployment is ready at [url]. It expires in [time] unless you claim it at [claimUrl]. Don't share the claim link.

risks.risk: In the package C1 examined, which held deploy.sh and deploy-codex.sh, those scripts post project code to claude-skills-deploy.vercel.com and codex-deploy-skills.vercel.sh and take instructions or URLs back at run time, an external dependency the agent cannot verify.
risks.mitigation: none stated, the scripts C1 names are not among the files at 1a2c79d4

risks.risk: Anyone who gets the claim link of a temporary deployment can claim that deployment.
risks.mitigation: the user is told not to share the claim link, in place in the message

risks.risk: git add . stages every change in the project, so files with secrets that are not ignored can be committed and pushed to the remote and deployed.
risks.mitigation: the user is asked before pushing, in place, no files are excluded

risks.risk: The no-auth fallback deploys the project to a temporary production URL without a confirmation step, so project files become reachable on the web.

limitations: Temporary deployments don't work in CI or in a directory already linked to a Vercel project.
A temporary deployment expires unless it is claimed.
vercel login is not possible in non-interactive environments.
Without an authenticated CLI, the preview URL of a git push deploy has to be found in the Vercel dashboard or the commit status checks.
vercel link without --repo matches by directory name and often fails when the local folder and the Vercel project are named differently.

known_problems.problem: deployment fails due to network restrictions on claude.ai
known_problems.workaround: add *.vercel.com and registry.npmjs.org to the allowed domains at https://claude.ai/settings/capabilities and deploy again

known_problems.problem: deployment fails due to network issues in Codex or a sandboxed environment
known_problems.workaround: rerun the deploy command with sandbox_permissions=require_escalated

known_problems.problem: vercel login or vercel deploy fails with authentication errors
known_problems.workaround: use the no-auth fallback, vercel deploy --temporary -y

known_problems.problem: state detection in an unlinked directory prompts or links as a side effect
known_problems.workaround: use only vercel whoami there, not vercel project inspect, vercel ls or vercel link
